prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Mexican woman — the personification of Mexico City — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Mexico City as her world knows it — a storybook gaslamp-fantasy city: gleaming brass, polished wood, glass, silk, lace and feathers, clockwork details, warm gaslight and soft white steam — clean, warm and storybook-bright, never sooty, rusty or grimy. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, airships or a skyline unless the place below names them. Wherever the place below sounds sooty, smoky, grimy or rusty, show it clean and gleaming instead.

Place: a gaslit wrestling hall at night — masked wrestlers in bright satin masks and capes leaping from the ropes of a canvas ring, brass lamps swinging overhead and the crowd roaring from tiered wooden benches.
Around her, as her world makes them: a bright laced satin wrestler's mask trimmed with little brass eyelets, held in her hand; a tin rattle on a wooden handle; a thick pressed-glass tumbler.
Season: the warm dry spring — but she is indoors: show the season only through a window or in her clothing; no blossoms, petals, falling leaves, snow or trees inside the room.
Time of day: evening turning to night — the scene lit by its own lamps and windows under a dark sky; warm pools of lamplight, soft shadow beyond.
Hair: her hair in a single loose braid over one shoulder — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a 1970s crochet halter top with low-rise flared jeans — in a monochrome palette of black and charcoal with at most one white or grey accent; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress of a storybook gaslamp city — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of cotton, fine wool, silk, lace and soft leather, with brass buttons, buckles and hooks, silk ribbons and laced boots, neat and clean.
POSTURE: perched on a ledge or edge.
SUPPORT: she sits on the edge, her weight on her hips.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the right of the frame; head tilted slightly, her face turned a little toward the right of the frame; camera slightly above, looking down at her; a soft out-of-focus object of the place sits in the near foreground at one edge of the frame; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right fingertips rest lightly on her cheek.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand braces on the edge beside her hip.
LEGS: knees together, feet slightly apart.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: slightly furrowed brow, softened eyes, lips lightly pressed together.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, hologram, digital display, touchscreen, bomber jacket, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles, soot, grime, rust, coal smoke, sweat stains, photographic texture.

observations: 루차 리브레 경기의 객석 가장자리에 걸터앉아 한 손으로 볼을 받치고 다른 손으로 난간을 짚었다. 보헤미안 자수 의상, 가스등과 가면을 확인했다.
